title: AI keys: detect the provider on the device (move the pure detection rules to shared), and allow changing the model without pasting the key again (contract change)
description: From review-dcxr.md items 6 and 13. Detection is five pure regexes in api/src/ai/detect.ts but the client POSTs the full key to /ai/provider-detect on every pause; move the rules to shared/src and run them in the client. Changing the model currently requires re-entering the key because PUT /ai/credentials requires api_key; add a model-only update.
